verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a first-party Approvals feature: members can request approval for a flag change from a member or team, so a review workflow exists in the product. The evidence only describes requesting approval as an option, not enforcing it as mandatory for production environments. missing for 10: documented enforcement of required approvals scoped to production environments, detail on blocking changes until approved, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: they have the option to request approval for that change from a member or team in their LaunchDarkly project.
Approvals let more people have input on planned changes.
